title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
abstract: arXiv:2608.23874v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. translated_title: 差分学习用于热稳定性稳健预测及其在含能材料中的应用
translated_abstract: 在处理和储存过程中预测热稳定性对于设计安全可靠的含能材料至关重要。然而，由于不同实验室在实验方案和分析方法上的差异，实验测量值之间存在显著波动，这使得训练可靠的预测模型变得困难。我们通过差分学习来解决这一挑战。我们不是预测绝对的分解温度，而是训练消息传递神经网络来预测分子对之间的相对差异。这种方法降低了对系统性实验误差的敏感性，并在根据热稳定性对化合物进行排序时实现了超过85%的准确率，优于在同一异构数据集上使用传统回归方法的表现。为了理解这些预测的驱动因素，我们将神经网络模型与基于从头计算和化学信息学软件所得描述符构建的可解释替代模型进行了比较。
tldr: 本文提出一种差分学习框架，通过预测分子间热稳定性的相对差异而非绝对值，显著提高了含能材料热稳定性排序的稳健性和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differential learning framework that predicts relative differences in thermal stability between molecular pairs rather than absolute values, significantly improving the robustness and accuracy of ranking energetic materials by thermal stability.
